pyqs.answer: Statement I true; Statement II false
pyqs.independentSolution: O2+ / O2 / O2− / O2²− have 1/2/3/4 electrons in the two degenerate π*2p orbitals. Remaining valence orbitals contribute Nb=8 and Na=2. Bond orders 2.5/2/1.5/1; bond lengths increase in this order. Unpaired counts 1/2/1/0: O2+ and O2− tie, invalidating strict > in statement II.

pyqs.answer: Third diagram: opposite phases on facing side-by-side lobes, with an internuclear node
pyqs.independentSolution: Internuclear axis z: π orbitals arise from side-on p orbitals perpendicular to z. Opposite phase on facing upper lobes, and on facing lower lobes, cancels density between nuclei. Third diagram has this arrangement. First is bonding π; fourth is end-on, hence σ type. Shading denotes phase, not charge.

targetQuestionText: Consider two statements about O₂⁺, O₂, O₂⁻ and O₂²⁻. I: Their bond lengths increase in that order. II: Their numbers of unpaired electrons follow O₂ > O₂⁺ > O₂⁻ > O₂²⁻. Which statements are correct?
